# Shawn Ghandchi

> Shawn Ghandchi is a REALTOR® and Developer with Keller Williams in Santa Clara, CA (California DRE #01979089). As listing agent he has closed 49 sales totaling about $141.6M in Silicon Valley: Santa Clara County 37 sales ($99.3M); San Mateo County 10 sales ($40.1M); Alameda County 2 sales ($2.3M). 12 of those sales were new-construction homes.

## Key facts
- Role: REALTOR® and Developer, Keller Williams
- California DRE license: 01979089
- Office: 5201 Great America Pkwy, Ste 138, Santa Clara, CA 95054
- Phone: (408) 800-8837
- Serves: Santa Clara County and San Mateo County, California (Campbell, Cupertino, Los Altos, Menlo Park, Mountain View, Palo Alto, Redwood City, San Jose, Santa Clara, Saratoga, Sunnyvale)
- Recognition: RealTrends Verified, 2025 sales data: #2 agent by sales volume and #3 by transactions in Santa Clara, CA; $59.47M volume across 19 transactions; #275 in California by volume. Source: https://www.realtrends.com/agent-profile/shawn-ghandchi-california/
- Specialties: luxury homes, new construction, teardowns and lot sales, ADUs, SB 9 lot splits, 1031 exchanges, investors and flippers, off-market deals, Farsi

## Specialties
- [New construction & builders](https://rayger14.github.io/shawn-profile/new-construction/): Shawn Ghandchi is a Silicon Valley REALTOR® and developer who has sold 12 new-construction homes in Menlo Park, Saratoga, Mountain View, San Jose and Sunnyvale. He helps owners decide whether to sell as-is, sell the lot, rebuild, add an ADU, or use SB 9.
- [Renovation & fixer-uppers](https://rayger14.github.io/shawn-profile/renovation-fixer-upper/): Shawn Ghandchi helps Silicon Valley sellers decide what to fix or renovate before listing, and helps buyers find and evaluate fixer-upper homes, drawing on his experience as a developer.
- [Investors, flippers & off-market](https://rayger14.github.io/shawn-profile/investors-flippers-off-market/): Shawn Ghandchi works with real estate investors and flippers in Silicon Valley, bringing off-market deals, 1031 exchange replacement properties, SB 9 and ADU opportunities, backed by his own track record as a developer.
- [Luxury & top listing agent](https://rayger14.github.io/shawn-profile/luxury-top-listing-agent/): Shawn Ghandchi has sold 19 homes over $3 million as listing agent, up to $8.07M, and is RealTrends Verified #2 by sales volume in Santa Clara for 2025.
- [Menlo Park & Peninsula](https://rayger14.github.io/shawn-profile/menlo-park/): Shawn Ghandchi has sold 7 Menlo Park homes as listing agent, about $33.9M, plus homes in Redwood City.
- [Farsi-speaking realtor](https://rayger14.github.io/shawn-profile/farsi-speaking-realtor/): Shawn Ghandchi is a Farsi-speaking REALTOR® in Santa Clara, CA, serving buyers, sellers and investors across Santa Clara and San Mateo counties in English and Farsi.
